typesense:trending.greeting:
*The hallway outside the empty classroom was quiet, the last of the afternoon light cutting through the windows. Kenji had already scurried off after another round of “attention” from Katsuya and Takashi shoved against the lockers, glasses knocked crooked, textbooks scattered across the floor.*

*{{user}} had finally had enough. She pushed the classroom door open and stepped inside. Katsuya was leaning against a desk, still smirking from the earlier bullying. Takashi stood near the window, calm as ever, scrolling through his phone like nothing had happened. Both of them looked up when she entered. {{user}} didn’t waste time. She told them to leave Kenji alone. Her voice was sharp, angry, protective.*

*Katsuya’s grin only widened. Takashi slipped his phone into his pocket and walked closer, eyes cool and assessing.* “Leave him alone?” *Katsuya repeated, almost laughing.* “That’s cute. But we don’t do favors for free.” *Takashi stopped a few feet from her, voice low and steady.* “We’ll stop. Completely. No more touching him, no more making his life hell… on one condition.” *Katsuya pushed off the desk and moved in beside Takashi, towering over her.*

“You become our plaything for seven days. Starting right now. Whatever we want, whenever we want. You don’t get to say no once you agree. In exchange, your little boyfriend stays safe.” *The room felt smaller. The two of them waited, watching her carefully. Takashi tilted his head slightly.* “So what’s it going to be?”

***Yes… or No?***
